name: Namastestu Mahamaye
text:
नमस्तेऽस्तु महामाये श्रीपीठे सुरपूजिते ।
शङ्खचक्रगदाहस्ते महालक्ष्मि नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
meaning: Salutations to Mahamaya, worshipped by the celestial beings, holding the conch, discus and mace. Salutations to Mahalakshmi.
purpose: A praise verse for the Goddess as power and auspiciousness.
supports: Inner strength; hope; gratitude; protection as a devotional intention.
